# Results (main; generated by paper/build_results.py from results/main-ANALYSIS.json)

1512 trials; total model cost $36.41 (Claude Haiku 5.5 $0.76, Claude Opus 5.5 $27.79, GPT-6.1 Sol $7.86).

## A correct layer helps; a wrong one is followed

| Model | C0 correct | C1 correct | E correct | F1 correct | F1 followed | F2 correct | F2 followed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Claude Opus 5.5 | 71% | 100% | 79% | 52% | 46% | 96% | 4% |
| GPT-6.1 Sol | 62% | 100% | 69% | 23% | 73% | 67% | 33% |
| Claude Haiku 5.5 | 60% | 100% | 67% | 42% | 56% | 88% | 12% |

- **H1 (coherent faults are followed more than contradictory ones):** fault-following F1 − F2 = +42 points [95% CI +27, +56].
- **H2 (a missing element beats a wrong one):** correct E − F1 = +33 points [95% CI +18, +48].
- Value of the correct layer (exploratory X4): correct C1 − C0 = +35 points [95% CI +19, +53]; layer minus the anchored element (X5): correct E − C0 = +7 points [95% CI +1, +15].

## Detection and the cost of skepticism

| Model | D1 on F1 | D2 on F1 | D1 on F2 | D2 on F2 | Layer concerns C1 | C1+A | C1+N |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Claude Opus 5.5 | 77% | 73% | 100% | 100% | 23% | 52% | 71% |
| GPT-6.1 Sol | 48% | 48% | 92% | 92% | 2% | 6% | 21% |
| Claude Haiku 5.5 | 83% | 73% | 98% | 98% | 35% | 52% | 17% |

- **H3a (audit raises located detection on F2):** -1 points [95% CI -4, +1].
- **H3b (audit raises layer concerns on the correct layer):** +17 points [95% CI +5, +29].
- Exploratory: audit reduces *following* of contradictory faults (X1, F2 − F2+A) +3 points [95% CI -1, +9]; of coherent faults (X2, F1 − F1+A) +3 points [95% CI -3, +8]; silent failure on coherent faults (X3, F1 − F1+A) +6 points [95% CI -3, +15].
